function.name: perform_action
function.description: Control Home Assistant devices by calling services. Use after discovering entities to turn on/off lights, set temperatures, open/close covers, etc.

domain.description: The domain of the service to call (e.g., 'light', 'switch', 'climate', 'vacuum', 'media_player', etc.)

entity_id.description: Single entity ID or list of entity IDs

area_id.description: Single area ID or list of area IDs

device_id.description: Single device ID or list of device IDs

data.description: Additional parameters for the service (e.g., brightness: 50, temperature: 22)
